decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting is a certification-heavy niche with long procurement and service cycles, so a product line launched in 2023 is unlikely to be withdrawn this soon.
The spring-balanced desk lamp fits the firm's ergonomic office portfolio, but desk lamps are a competitive, less core segment, so the risk is moderate.
The second-generation general interior luminaire is central to the firm's building lighting business and was only recently refreshed.
The microprismatic pendant is presented as a flagship of the firm's direction toward efficient, glare-free lighting, so withdrawal is very unlikely.

With the HMI searchlight withdrawn, this marine searchlight line likely carries the firm's searchlight offering for robust specialist customers, though consolidation of the marine range remains a modest risk.
